scope: Complete current-card source graph, enabled and disabled actions, exact clip references, per-event static schedules with external handoffs and random intervals retained.

notes: Birth and Idle components are present but empty. Do not invent an automatic completion or one-second windup.
The Animation component lists a Death event clip, but no serialized Death SpellState exists. That clip is not a reachable Death route.
Action events below are relative to explicit ActivateState(Action), not prefab instantiation.
Action arrays in a state run in original index order; ordinary states are parallel.
SpellFinishAction delays callback only, then immediately Finish()s the action. It does not delay the FSM transition.
An explicit FINISHED event from a timed action can transition while everyFrame actions remain active.
Death is a spell visual lifecycle state, not necessarily a game entity death.
Callers must not treat source-derived-complete event schedule as proof all renderer/shader actions are implemented.
Schedules with random_gates must sample once per source gate and share the draw across sibling layers, separately from game-rule RNG. A null at is an interval, never a zero delay.
SpellStateAnimation is an explicitly normalized legacy source action, not a PlayMaker class. Execute original clip at m_AnimSpeed on target GameObject. Audio remains original v30 separate ownership.
Every FSM route includes __start__: execute once per instance before global Birth/Action/Death. It is not itself an original global event.
